__comment: The colony's journal (doc 23), read by ColonyJournal: how many days of lines it keeps, how often (real seconds) it looks at the dwarves' thoughts, and how many game hours a memory's age must fall back by to count as the thought coming again. lines holds what a dwarf says when a thought begins, a few per thought, keyed by the thought's id in DwarfMood.thoughts(), and when a dwarf finds a taste (found_love, found_like, found_dislike; {thing} is the thing's name). The dwarf's id, the day and the topic choose one, so a journal reads the same after a load.

bedroom: A door that shuts and a bed of my own. Bliss.
Slept like a stone. My own stone, in my own room.
Nobody snoring but me. Best night in an age.
recreation_together: A good game of stones after work. I won, mostly.
Lost at stones and laughed anyway.
Three games, two arguments, one friend. A fine evening.
recreation_alone: Beat myself twice. It still counts.
Played both sides. Both sides cheated.
hungry: My stomach growls louder than the picks.
I keep thinking about berries. Any berries.
famished: I would eat the bark off a log.
dining_seat_only: A stool is fine. A table would be finer.
dining_table_only: Ate standing up, like a pack mule.
A table and nowhere to sit. Who plans these halls?
dining_neither: No seat and no table. Just berries in the dark.
Ate in the dirt like a mole.
cold: Too cold to sleep and too tired not to.
My breath froze on the blanket.
chilly: Woke with frost in my beard. A hearth would not go amiss.
My toes have not been warm since we came down here.
hot: Like sleeping in a bread oven.
Sweated through the night. Bank that hearth.
slept_horrid: Tripped over a log on the way to bed. Then over another.
Woke up beside a sack of stones. Not the company I wanted.
slept_pleasant: A tidy room makes for a tidy sleep.
Planks underfoot and a hearth glowing. A good night.
slept_beautiful: Woke up and just lay there, admiring the beams.
Who knew a room could make a dwarf glad to wake?
ate_horrid: Supper between the stockpiles. Everything tasted of sawdust.
Ate with a heap of rubble for company.
ate_pleasant: A good meal in a good room. That is all I ask.
The stew tasted better for the room.
ate_beautiful: Dined like a lord tonight. The room did half the work.
Lingered over my bowl just to stay in that room.
played_horrid: Hard to plan a move with junk piled at your elbow.
Lost the game. Blame the mess.
played_pleasant: A fine game in a fine room.
Good board, good company, good room.
played_beautiful: Played in our grandest room. Felt like a feast day.
Even losing felt grand in there.
found_love: Never knew a {thing} could feel like home.
That {thing}! Where has it been all my life?
found_like: I could get used to a {thing}.
found_dislike: A {thing}, of all things. Never again, if I can help it.
Whoever chose that {thing} owes me an apology.
